name: Paimbnails
description: Thumbnails, capture, visual effects, audio, emotes, profiles, and custom backgrounds for Geometry Dash.

auto-update.name: Auto Update
auto-update.description: Download and apply updates automatically when the game closes.

mod-previews-enable.name: Mod Previews
mod-previews-enable.description: Show preview images for Geode mods whose repository has a 'previews' folder (preview-1.png ... preview-10.png).

level-search-enter.name: Quick Search Key
level-search-enter.description: Key to trigger search in the level browser.

realtime-search-preview.name: Realtime Search Preview
realtime-search-preview.description: Shows search results as you type.

smooth-scroll.name: Smooth Scroll
smooth-scroll.description: Smooth mouse wheel scrolling in menus and lists.

search-history-title.name: Search History
search-history-title.description: Save and re-run your recent level searches.

incognito-mode.name: Incognito Mode
incognito-mode.description: Hide the search history button and stop saving any searches.

discord-rpc-enabled.name: Enable Discord Rich Presence
discord-rpc-enabled.description: Show your activity on Discord. Configure details in Paimon Hub > Discord.

level-thumb-width.name: Thumbnail Size
level-thumb-width.description: Width of the thumbnail area in level cells.

compact-list-mode.name: Compact Mode
compact-list-mode.description: Shorter level cells to fit more on screen.

auto-preview-title.name: Auto Previews
auto-preview-title.description: Generate a thumbnail for levels that have none by rendering a small zone of the level.

auto-preview-enable.name: Auto Previews
auto-preview-enable.description: For levels with no thumbnail, automatically generate one. By default this happens for free when you play such a level (a clean frame is captured and reused as its thumbnail everywhere).

auto-preview-quality.name: Preview Quality
auto-preview-quality.description: Resolution of generated previews. Higher = sharper but a bit larger on disk.

auto-preview-badge.name: Show 'AUTO' Badge
auto-preview-badge.description: Mark auto-generated previews so they are not confused with real, community-made thumbnails.

auto-preview-browser-gen.name: Generate In Level List (Experimental)
auto-preview-browser-gen.description: EXPERIMENTAL, desktop only. Also generate previews directly from the level browser by rendering levels off-screen, without you having to play them. This is heavy (each level is fully loaded once) and is rate-limited to one at a time. Leave off if you notice instability.

auto-preview-max-objects.name: Max Level Size
auto-preview-max-objects.description: Skip browser generation for levels with more objects than this (avoids long freezes on huge levels).

auto-preview-max-per-session.name: Max Previews Per Session
auto-preview-max-per-session.description: Hard cap on how many browser previews are generated each time you open the game.

auto-preview-clear.name: Clear Generated Previews
auto-preview-clear.description: Delete every auto-generated preview from disk. Real thumbnails and your own captures are not affected.

levelinfo-background-style.name: Background Style
levelinfo-background-style.description: Visual style of the level info background.

dynamic-song.name: Dynamic Song
dynamic-song.description: Play the level song at a random position when viewing level info.

profile-redesign-enabled.name: Redesign Profile
profile-redesign-enabled.description: Reimagines the profile page with a modern layered-card layout: an identity header, framed action rails, a stats strip, and a refined activity frame. Designed to combine with profile backgrounds and all other Paimbnails profile features.

profile-music-enabled.name: Enable Profile Music
profile-music-enabled.description: Play custom music when viewing profiles.

menuMusicEnable.name: Enable Menu Music Player
menuMusicEnable.description: Vinyl button in main menu for library, playlists and downloads.

menu-music-cover-debug.name: Menu Music Cover Debug
menu-music-cover-debug.description: Log cover loading diagnostics to Geode console and saveDir/menu-music/cover-debug.log (works even when Debug Logs is off).

open-menu-music-folder.name: Open Menu Music Folder
open-menu-music-folder.description: Open the folder with cover-debug.log, library.json and saved song covers.

editorMusicEnable.name: Enable Editor Music
editorMusicEnable.description: Listen to your music library inside the level editor on a separate audio channel. Toggle the mini player with the Editor Music keybind.

editorMusicToggleKeybind.name: Toggle Editor Music
editorMusicToggleKeybind.description: Show/hide the editor music mini player (only works inside the level editor).

editor-rotate-title.name: Editor Canvas Rotate
editor-rotate-title.description: Rotate the whole editor view to build at an angle.

editor-rotate-enable.name: Editor Canvas Rotate
editor-rotate-enable.description: Hold Alt and drag with the right mouse button in the level editor to rotate the whole canvas around the center of the screen (uses the game's native camera angle, so objects, grid and background all turn). Snaps to 45-degree steps. Building and dragging keep working while rotated.

editor-rotate-slider-thumb.name: Rotate Slider Thumb
editor-rotate-slider-thumb.description: Rotate the editor's position-slider thumb to match the current canvas angle, so you can read the rotation at a glance.

editor-rotate-reset-keybind.name: Reset Editor Rotation
editor-rotate-reset-keybind.description: Snap the editor canvas back to upright (0 degrees).

menuLoopConstantShuffle.name: Menu Loop Shuffle
menuLoopConstantShuffle.description: Change menu loops automatically after each song finishes.

menuLoopEnableNotification.name: Now Playing Notifications
menuLoopEnableNotification.description: Show a toast when the menu loop song changes.

menuLoopNotificationTime.name: Notification Duration
menuLoopNotificationTime.description: How long the Now Playing toast stays on screen (seconds).

menuLoopCustomPrefix.name: Notification Prefix
menuLoopCustomPrefix.description: Text shown before the song name in the toast. Use [Empty] to hide.

menuLoopSeekAmountMs.name: Seek Step (ms)
menuLoopSeekAmountMs.description: Milliseconds the skip forward/backward buttons move.

menuLoopShowPlaybackProgress.name: Show Playback Progress
menuLoopShowPlaybackProgress.description: Show the seek bar and skip buttons inside the Menu Music popup.

menuLoopEnableKeyboardShortcuts.name: Menu Music Hotkeys
menuLoopEnableKeyboardShortcuts.description: YouTube/VLC/Spotify-like hotkeys inside the Menu Music popup (0-9 to seek, Ctrl+S to shuffle, etc.).

menuLoopSaveSongOnGameClose.name: Remember Last Menu Loop
menuLoopSaveSongOnGameClose.description: Resume the last menu loop when you reopen the game.

menuLoopRandomizeOnLevelExit.name: Randomize on Level Exit
menuLoopRandomizeOnLevelExit.description: Pick a new menu loop when you quit back from a level.

menuLoopRestoreOnLevelExit.name: Restore Position on Level Exit
menuLoopRestoreOnLevelExit.description: Resume the previous menu loop from where it was when you return from a level.

menuLoopRandomizeOnEditorExit.name: Randomize on Editor Exit
menuLoopRandomizeOnEditorExit.description: Pick a new menu loop when you quit from the editor.

menuLoopRestoreOnEditorExit.name: Restore Position on Editor Exit
menuLoopRestoreOnEditorExit.description: Resume the previous menu loop from where it was when you return from the editor.

smooth-ui-enabled.name: Smooth UI
smooth-ui-enabled.description: Enables the Smooth UI control center in Paimon Hub > Extras: softer popups, button motion, smooth scroll, blur fades, and transition tuning.

colorful-icons-enabled.name: Paimon Icons (Recolor)
colorful-icons-enabled.description: Recolor every icon in the icon kit and shops: your colors, fixed colors, gradient, rainbow, random and more. Everything is configured from the round cube button in the garage, with a live preview.

global-icons-enabled.name: Global Icons
global-icons-enabled.description: Show other players' shared custom icons on their profile, and share yours from the profile settings gear. Requires the More Icons mod.

global-icon-server-url.name: Global Icon Server URL
global-icon-server-url.description: Base URL of your deployed Global Icon server (Vercel). Must match the server whose PAIMON_API_KEY equals the mod's API key.

custom-slider-enabled.name: Custom Slider Thumb
custom-slider-enabled.description: Replace slider thumbs with your player icon.

dynamic-popup-enabled.name: Dynamic Popups
dynamic-popup-enabled.description: Custom entry/exit animations for Paimbnails popups.

dynamic-exit-enabled.name: Dynamic Popup Exit
dynamic-exit-enabled.description: Apply dynamic transition effects when closing Paimbnails popups.

popup-blur-enabled.name: Popup Blur
popup-blur-enabled.description: Blur the background behind Paimbnails popups.

popup-ui-theme.name: Popup UI Theme
popup-ui-theme.description: Visual style of Paimbnails popups. 'gd' = original, 'glass' = blur + black borders, 'dark' = dark mode, 'carbon' = carbon fiber, 'aurora' = animated gradient border, 'minimal' = clean with soft shadow. Glass/Dark/Carbon/Aurora enable popup blur automatically.

custom-cursor-enable.name: Custom Cursor
custom-cursor-enable.description: Replace the OS cursor with a custom image.

touch-prio-title.name: Touch Priority
touch-prio-title.description: Route touches by on-screen depth (Z order) instead of GD's touch-priority value.

touch-prio-enable.name: Z-Order Touch
touch-prio-enable.description: Decide which node gets a touch by what's visually on top (Z order + order of arrival) instead of the raw touch-priority value. Fixes pressing buttons behind popups and touch layers leaking through. Automatically disabled if the standalone 'Better Touch Prio' mod is installed.

touch-prio-debug-logs.name: Touch Priority: Debug Logs
touch-prio-debug-logs.description: Log which node claims each touch and warn about leaked handlers. For troubleshooting only.

smooth-text-enabled.name: Smooth Text Input
smooth-text-enabled.description: Characters gently fade, rise and pop in as you type in text fields, and fade away when deleted. Geode setting inputs are left untouched to avoid glitches.

smooth-text-fade-in.name: Text: Fade In
smooth-text-fade-in.description: How long a new character takes to appear (seconds). 0 = instant.

smooth-text-fade-out.name: Text: Fade Out
smooth-text-fade-out.description: How long a deleted character takes to vanish (seconds). 0 = instant.

smooth-text-rise.name: Text: Rise Distance
smooth-text-rise.description: How far characters glide up into place (pixels). 0 = pure fade, no motion.

smooth-text-scale-pop.name: Text: Scale Pop
smooth-text-scale-pop.description: Characters also spring up from a smaller size for a bouncier feel.

enable-thumbnail-taking.name: Enable Capture Button
enable-thumbnail-taking.description: Show capture button in pause menu.

settings-panel-keybind.name: Open Settings Panel
settings-panel-keybind.description: Key to open/close the Paimon settings panel.

capture-keybind.name: Capture Thumbnail
capture-keybind.description: Key to capture a thumbnail during gameplay.

capture-menu-keybind.name: Open Capture Menu
capture-menu-keybind.description: Key (or mouse button) that opens the capture menu when not playing. Works as an alternative or replacement for right-click. Examples: A, Ctrl+A.

capture-menu-rightclick.name: Open Capture Menu with Right-Click
capture-menu-rightclick.description: When enabled, right-click opens the capture menu (default behavior). Disable it if you prefer to use only the 'Open Capture Menu' keybind above.

zoom-in-keybind.name: Zoom In
zoom-in-keybind.description: Zoom in while the game is paused.

zoom-out-keybind.name: Zoom Out
zoom-out-keybind.description: Zoom out while the game is paused.

zoom-reset-keybind.name: Reset Pause Zoom
zoom-reset-keybind.description: Reset zoom and show the pause menu.

zoom-toggle-menu-keybind.name: Toggle Pause Menu
zoom-toggle-menu-keybind.description: Hide or show the pause menu during pause zoom.

main-menu-layout-keybind.name: Layout Editor
main-menu-layout-keybind.description: Opens the button layout editor on the main menu and pause menu.

volume-scroll-title.name: Volume Scroll
volume-scroll-title.description: Modifier + scroll wheel to change volume in-game and in the editor.

volume-music-mod-game.name: Music Volume (Game)
volume-music-mod-game.description: Hold this key (or right-click / a configured mouse button) while scrolling to change the music volume during gameplay. Can be a single key (e.g. T), a modifier (Ctrl), or a combination (Ctrl+T).

volume-sfx-mod-game.name: SFX Volume (Game)
volume-sfx-mod-game.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the SFX volume during gameplay.

volume-music-mod-editor.name: Music Volume (Editor)
volume-music-mod-editor.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the music volume in the level editor.

volume-sfx-mod-editor.name: SFX Volume (Editor)
volume-sfx-mod-editor.description: Hold this key while scrolling to change the SFX volume in the level editor.

enable-disk-cache.name: Disk Cache
enable-disk-cache.description: Save thumbnails to disk to avoid re-downloading.

gd-robtop-cache-enabled.name: RobTop Response Cache
gd-robtop-cache-enabled.description: Cache Geometry Dash server responses (profiles, level searches, comments, etc.) on disk for 7 days to reduce rate limits. Live message/friend polling is never cached.

clear-cache-on-exit.name: Clear Cache on Exit
clear-cache-on-exit.description: Delete cached thumbnails when the game closes.

open-thumbnails-folder.name: Open Thumbnails Folder
open-thumbnails-folder.description: Open the folder where downloaded thumbnails are stored on disk.

texture-studio-enabled.name: Enable Texture Studio Button
texture-studio-enabled.description: Show the Texture Studio button in the main menu.

texture-studio-auto-apply.name: Auto-apply on Generate
texture-studio-auto-apply.description: Automatically copy generated packs to Texture Loader's packs folder.

comment-mentions-title.name: Comment Mentions
comment-mentions-title.description: Get notified when someone mentions you in level comments.

mentions-enabled.name: Enable Comment Mentions
mentions-enabled.description: Periodically check level comments and notify you when your name (or an alias) is mentioned. This makes requests to the Geometry Dash servers while you play.

mentions-aliases.name: Aliases
mentions-aliases.description: Comma separated names to watch for in comments. Defaults to your username on first launch.

mentions-enable-everyone.name: Notify on @everyone
mentions-enable-everyone.description: Also get notified when a comment uses the @everyone alias.

mentions-require-at.name: Require @ Sign
mentions-require-at.description: Only notify when the mention starts with a literal '@'.

mentions-custom-ids.name: Custom Level IDs
mentions-custom-ids.description: Comma separated level IDs whose comments will also be checked.

mentions-refresh-rate.name: Refresh Rate (s)
mentions-refresh-rate.description: How often (in seconds) the servers are checked. Low values may get you rate limited.

mentions-max-notifications.name: Max Notifications
mentions-max-notifications.description: If more than this many new mentions arrive at once, they are compressed into a single notification.

mentions-user-blacklist.name: User Blacklist
mentions-user-blacklist.description: Comma separated usernames you don't want notifications from.

mentions-word-blacklist.name: Hidden Words
mentions-word-blacklist.description: Comma separated words; comments containing any of them are ignored. Leave empty to disable filtering.

msgnotif-title.name: Message Notifications
msgnotif-title.description: Get notified when you receive a new message or friend request. Polls the Geometry Dash servers while logged in.

msgnotif-enabled.name: Enable Message Notifications
msgnotif-enabled.description: Periodically check for new messages and friend requests and show a notification.

msgnotif-check-interval.name: Check Interval (s)
msgnotif-check-interval.description: How often (in seconds) to check for new messages and friend requests. Low values may get you temporarily IP banned.

msgnotif-stop-friends.name: Stop Friend Request Notifications
msgnotif-stop-friends.description: Disable notifications for new friend requests.

msgnotif-disable-while-editing.name: Disable While Editing
msgnotif-disable-while-editing.description: Don't check while in the level editor.

v107-title.name: New Features (v1.0.7)
v107-title.description: Song search by name, My Levels filters, and menu physics.

song-search-enable.name: Search Song By Name
song-search-enable.description: Type a song name in the custom-song ID box and the first Newgrounds match is selected automatically. Numeric IDs still work as usual.

editor-filters-enable.name: My Levels Filters
editor-filters-enable.description: Adds a filter button to the My Levels tab to filter your created levels by length, verification status, and song ID.

menu-physics-enable.name: Menu Physics
menu-physics-enable.description: Buttons drop with realistic rotation, bounce, roll on the floor, squash on impact, and can be dragged/thrown. Click empty space to push them. Toggle also from the right-click menu. Just for fun.

menu-physics-gravity.name: Physics: Gravity
menu-physics-gravity.description: Strength of gravity for Menu Physics. Negative pulls down, positive pulls up.

menu-physics-bounciness.name: Physics: Bounciness
menu-physics-bounciness.description: How much buttons bounce off walls and each other. 0 = no bounce, 1 = super bouncy.

menu-physics-friction.name: Physics: Friction
menu-physics-friction.description: Surface friction: higher values make buttons roll and stop spinning sooner on the floor.

menu-physics-air-drag.name: Physics: Air Drag
menu-physics-air-drag.description: How much buttons slow down while flying. 0 = no drag, 1 = very floaty.

menu-physics-angular-drag.name: Physics: Spin Drag
menu-physics-angular-drag.description: How fast buttons stop spinning in the air. 0 = spin forever, 2 = stop quickly.

menu-physics-push-power.name: Physics: Push Power
menu-physics-push-power.description: Click empty space to fling nearby buttons with spin. 0 = disabled, 2 = very strong.

menu-physics-mass-by-size.name: Physics: Mass By Size
menu-physics-mass-by-size.description: Bigger buttons are heavier, harder to spin, and push smaller ones around more realistically.

menu-physics-remove-ceiling.name: Physics: Remove Ceiling
menu-physics-remove-ceiling.description: Let buttons fly out past the top of the screen instead of bouncing off it.

editor-colorpicker-title.name: Editor Color Picker
editor-colorpicker-title.description: Eyedropper tool inside the level editor.

editor-color-picker-enable.name: Editor Color Picker
editor-color-picker-enable.description: Adds a square eyedropper button to the editor's top-right button menu. It freezes the screen, shows an imagecolorpicker-style magnifier, and lets you click any pixel to pick its color. Copy it as HEX / RGB / GD format, or type a color channel ID to load the picked color into Geometry Dash's color editor.

editor-color-picker-keybind.name: Open Color Picker (Editor)
editor-color-picker-keybind.description: Opens the editor color picker eyedropper. Only works inside the level editor.

editor-history-title.name: Editor Undo (Color / Groups / Layers)
editor-history-title.description: Simple undo for color, group and editor-layer changes only.

editor-history-enable.name: Editor Undo (Color / Groups / Layers)
editor-history-enable.description: Adds a button to the editor toolbar. Pick Color, Groups or Layers and undo the last change of that type. Does not track move/rotate/create/delete.

editor-suite-title.name: Paimon Editor Suite
editor-suite-title.description: Modular editor improvements inspired by Tinker and BetterEdit. Toggle each module independently in Módulos or here. Master switch only gates editor-mod-* features.

editor-suite-enable.name: Editor Suite (Master)
editor-suite-enable.description: Master switch for all new editor-mod-* modules. Pre-existing features (rotate, color picker, history, collab, music) keep their own toggles.

editor-mod-scroll-zoom.name: Smooth Scroll & Zoom
editor-mod-scroll-zoom.description: Better editor pan/zoom. Ctrl+wheel zooms (to cursor), Shift+wheel pans horizontally.

editor-mod-scroll-zoom-to-cursor.name: Zoom to Cursor
editor-mod-scroll-zoom-to-cursor.description: Keep the point under the mouse fixed while zooming.

editor-mod-scroll-delegate-vanilla.name: Delegate Scroll to Vanilla
editor-mod-scroll-delegate-vanilla.description: Pass scroll to vanilla EditorUI::scrollWheel (better DevTools compat, worse with other scroll mods).

editor-mod-zoom-text.name: Zoom Level Text
editor-mod-zoom-text.description: Flash the current zoom percentage when zooming.

editor-mod-grid-control.name: Grid Controls
editor-mod-grid-control.description: Change editor grid size with +/- and a free input.

editor-mod-hide-ui.name: Hide UI Toggle
editor-mod-hide-ui.description: Button next to undo to hide/show the editor UI.

editor-mod-length-display.name: Length Display
editor-mod-length-display.description: Show estimated level length and object count in the editor HUD.

editor-mod-object-tooltips.name: Object Tooltips
editor-mod-object-tooltips.description: Show object ID tooltips when hovering build-tab buttons.

editor-mod-repeating-buttons.name: Repeating Buttons
editor-mod-repeating-buttons.description: Hold edit-tab buttons to auto-repeat them.

editor-mod-camera-tools.name: Camera Tools
editor-mod-camera-tools.description: Buttons and keys N/M: center camera on selection / move selection to camera.

editor-mod-single-deselect.name: Single Deselect
editor-mod-single-deselect.description: Hold Alt and click a selected object to deselect only that object.

editor-mod-copy-string.name: Copy Object String
editor-mod-copy-string.description: Also copy the object string to the system clipboard when copying in the editor.

editor-mod-paste-warnings.name: Paste Warnings
editor-mod-paste-warnings.description: Confirm before paste state / paste color on multi-selection.

editor-mod-fixes-pack.name: Editor Fixes Pack
editor-mod-fixes-pack.description: Slider length fix, centered create buttons, link control touch fix, NaN position crash guard.

editor-mod-ldm-count.name: LDM Object Count
editor-mod-ldm-count.description: Show high-detail object count on the editor pause screen.

editor-mod-wave-ignore-damage.name: Wave Ignore Damage Fix
editor-mod-wave-ignore-damage.description: Fixes wave treating all slopes as if they have D blocks when ignore damage is enabled.

editor-mod-negate-input.name: Negate Input
editor-mod-negate-input.description: Press N while a number field is focused to negate it.

editor-mod-scale-rotate.name: Improved Scale/Rotate
editor-mod-scale-rotate.description: Numeric scale/rotation inputs and Shift-to-snap while dragging controls.

editor-mod-type-in-layer.name: Type-in Layer
editor-mod-type-in-layer.description: Type the editor layer number, jump to next free layer, improved lock control.

editor-mod-next-free-offset.name: Next Free Offset
editor-mod-next-free-offset.description: Next Free group ID starts searching from a saved offset instead of 1.

editor-mod-start-pos.name: Start Pos Tools
editor-mod-start-pos.description: Prev/next start position switcher (Q/E) and playtest without start pos.

editor-mod-auto-build-helper.name: Auto Build Helper
editor-mod-auto-build-helper.description: When enabled, automatically run Build Helper after paste.

editor-mod-object-summary.name: Object Summary
editor-mod-object-summary.description: Button on editor pause listing counts of each object ID.

editor-mod-multi-text.name: Multi Text Edit
editor-mod-multi-text.description: When changing one text object, apply the same string to all selected text objects.

editor-mod-ui-scale.name: Editor UI Scale
editor-mod-ui-scale.description: Scale the editor HUD. Re-enter the editor after changing the scale.

editor-mod-button-rows.name: Button Rows Bypass
editor-mod-button-rows.description: Raise the limits for button rows and buttons per row in editor options.

editor-mod-move-keybinds.name: Move Fractions Keybinds
editor-mod-move-keybinds.description: Ctrl+Alt+WASD = half block, Alt+WASD = quarter block moves.

editor-mod-extra-keybinds.name: Extra Editor Keybinds
editor-mod-extra-keybinds.description: Ctrl+E edit object, Ctrl+G groups, R restart playtest, Ctrl+Shift+R rotate 45, etc.

editor-mod-group-view.name: Improved Group View
editor-mod-group-view.description: Show a scrollable full group list when many groups are used.

editor-mod-object-search.name: Object Search
editor-mod-object-search.description: Search objects by ID or name (Ctrl+Space) and select them in the build tab.

editor-mod-view-panel.name: View Toggles Panel
editor-mod-view-panel.description: Floating panel with quick toggles for grid, ground, hitboxes, hide LDM, effect lines.

editor-mod-trigger-lines.name: Trigger Indicators
editor-mod-trigger-lines.description: Draw lines from selected triggers to objects in their target group.

editor-mod-trigger-lines-all.name: Show All Trigger Lines
editor-mod-trigger-lines-all.description: Also draw lines for unselected triggers (heavier).

editor-mod-playtest-confirm.name: Playtest Confirmation
editor-mod-playtest-confirm.description: Show a confirmation popup before playtesting.

editor-mod-hide-level-ids.name: Hide Level IDs
editor-mod-hide-level-ids.description: Hide IDs on the Edit Level screen unless Shift is held.

editor-mod-duration-info.name: Duration HUD
editor-mod-duration-info.description: Show the duration of the selected trigger near the object info.

editor-mod-live-colors.name: Live Color Strip
editor-mod-live-colors.description: Show a strip of the level's main color channels at the bottom of the editor.

editor-mod-native-tabs.name: Native Editor Tabs
editor-mod-native-tabs.description: Show View / Search / Favs as Paimon side tabs (hides the duplicate floating View button).

editor-mod-object-favorites.name: Object Favorites
editor-mod-object-favorites.description: Right-click an object in the build bar to favorite it. Open favorites with the Favs button (next to Search).

editor-mod-edit-mixed.name: Edit Mixed Values
editor-mod-edit-mixed.description: Show min-max ranges for mixed layer/Z values and apply typed values to all selected objects.

editor-mod-trigger-lines-arrows.name: Trigger Line Arrows
editor-mod-trigger-lines-arrows.description: Draw arrow heads on trigger indicator lines.

editor-mod-trigger-lines-cluster.name: Cluster Trigger Targets
editor-mod-trigger-lines-cluster.description: Merge nearby target objects into one line endpoint.

editor-mod-scrollable-objects.name: Scrollable Object Bar
editor-mod-scrollable-objects.description: Scroll the mouse wheel over the build bar to change object pages.

editor-mod-preview-object-colors.name: Preview Object Colors
editor-mod-preview-object-colors.description: Tint create-tab object icons using the level object color channel.

editor-mod-reference-image.name: Reference Image
editor-mod-reference-image.description: Import a translucent reference image into the editor (button on undo menu).

editor-mod-group-summary.name: Group Summary
editor-mod-group-summary.description: List used group IDs from the pause menu or Ctrl+Shift+U.

editor-mod-quick-save.name: Quick Save Backup
editor-mod-quick-save.description: Button on the undo menu that writes a level-string backup under the mod save folder.

editor-mod-auto-save.name: Auto Save Backup
editor-mod-auto-save.description: Periodically write level-string backups while in the editor.

editor-mod-backups.name: Backups Browser
editor-mod-backups.description: Open a list of backups from the editor pause menu.

editor-mod-better-color-menu.name: Better Color Menu
editor-mod-better-color-menu.description: Show a strip of color channels on Color Select for quick picking.

editor-mod-better-font-select.name: Better Font Select
editor-mod-better-font-select.description: Scrollable font grid in the font select popup.

editor-mod-move-menu.name: Fractional Move Pad
editor-mod-move-menu.description: Half and quarter step move buttons on the right side of the editor. Off by default to keep the HUD clean (use Alt/Ctrl+Alt+WASD keybinds instead).

editor-mod-quick-extras.name: Quick Extras
editor-mod-quick-extras.description: Undo-menu button that opens Edit Special for the selection.

editor-mod-relocate-build-tools.name: Relocate Build Tools
editor-mod-relocate-build-tools.description: Build Helper, Align X/Y and Create Loop buttons on the editor HUD.

editor-mod-grid-colors.name: Custom Grid Color
editor-mod-grid-colors.description: Draw the editor grid in a color of your choice (solid or gradient), over the vanilla grid. Aligned to the current grid size.

editor-mod-grid-color-a.name: Grid Color
editor-mod-grid-color-a.description: Grid color as 'r,g,b' (0-255). This is the solid color, or the first color of the gradient.

editor-mod-grid-gradient.name: Grid Gradient
editor-mod-grid-gradient.description: Blend the grid between two colors across the visible area.

editor-mod-grid-alpha.name: Grid Opacity
editor-mod-grid-alpha.description: Opacity of the custom grid lines (0 = invisible, 255 = solid).

editor-mod-grid-line-width.name: Grid Line Width
editor-mod-grid-line-width.description: Thickness of the custom grid lines.

editor-mod-toolbar-colors.name: Toolbar Color Tint
editor-mod-toolbar-colors.description: Tint bottom toolbar panels using saved paim-toolbar-color (r,g,b).

editor-mod-joystick-nav.name: Alt+WASD Camera Pan
editor-mod-joystick-nav.description: Hold Alt and WASD/arrows to pan the editor canvas.

editor-mod-old-color-triggers.name: Old Color Trigger Look
editor-mod-old-color-triggers.description: Prefer classic tint-button frames for common color triggers (Tinker-style).

editor-mod-select-direction.name: Select All Left/Right
editor-mod-select-direction.description: Ctrl+Shift+Left/Right selects all objects in that direction (vanilla API).

editor-mod-editor-percentage.name: Editor Percentage
editor-mod-editor-percentage.description: Show approximate camera X as a percentage of level length at the top of the editor.

editor-mod-next-free-color.name: Next Free Color Offset
editor-mod-next-free-color.description: Show an offset field and improve next-free color channel picking in Color Select.

editor-mod-rotate-lock-pos.name: Lock Position While Rotating
editor-mod-rotate-lock-pos.description: Keep the selection center fixed while dragging the rotation control (BetterEdit-style).

editor-mod-back-to-content.name: Back To Content
editor-mod-back-to-content.description: Undo-menu button that centers the camera on the selection (or level content).

editor-mod-paste-object-string.name: Paste Object String
editor-mod-paste-object-string.description: Ctrl+Shift+P pastes objects from the system clipboard (object string).

editor-mod-duration-drag.name: Duration Drag
editor-mod-duration-drag.description: Hold Shift and drag horizontally on a selected duration trigger to change its duration.

editor-mod-dash-portal-lines.name: Dash & Portal Guides
editor-mod-dash-portal-lines.description: Draw guide lines for selected dash orbs and portals in the editor.

editor-mod-hide-trigger-ui.name: Hide Trigger UI on Slider
editor-mod-hide-trigger-ui.description: Dim the trigger popup while dragging sliders so you can see the level.

editor-mod-hsv-preview.name: HSV Preview Swatch
editor-mod-hsv-preview.description: Show a color swatch on the HSV configure widget.

collab-title.name: Collab Editor
collab-title.description: Real-time collaborative level editing over a Render server.

collab-enabled.name: Enable Collab Editor
collab-enabled.description: Show the Collab button in the editor. Requires the access code the first time.

collab-username.name: Collab Display Name
collab-username.description: Name other editors see in the room. Leave empty to use your GD username.

collab-invites.name: Collab Room Invites
collab-invites.description: Let friends invite you to their collab rooms while you're online, and receive an invite prompt. Turn off to stop connecting to the invite server.

collab-voice.name: Collab Voice Chat
collab-voice.description: Enable room voice chat (walkie-talkie style) during collab sessions. Toggle your mic with the Mic button inside the editor.

collab-voice-volume.name: Collab Voice Volume
collab-voice-volume.description: Playback volume for other editors' voices.

collab-voice-sensitivity.name: Collab Mic Sensitivity
collab-voice-sensitivity.description: Voice activation threshold. Lower values transmit with quieter input.

input-scroll-title.name: Input Scroll
input-scroll-title.description: Scroll the mouse wheel over a numeric text input to change its value one at a time. Hold a modifier for fine 0.10 steps on decimal inputs.

input-scroll-enable.name: Enable Input Scroll
input-scroll-enable.description: Hover a numeric text input and scroll the wheel to add or subtract 1 to its value.

input-scroll-step.name: Integer Step
input-scroll-step.description: Amount added or subtracted per wheel tick on integer inputs.

input-scroll-decimal-modifier.name: Decimal Step Modifier
input-scroll-decimal-modifier.description: Hold this key while scrolling on a decimal input to step by the decimal amount. Fn is not detectable on Windows, so pick Shift/Ctrl/Alt instead.

input-scroll-decimal-step.name: Decimal Step
input-scroll-decimal-step.description: Amount added or subtracted per wheel tick on decimal (float) inputs when the modifier is held.

input-scroll-decimal-places.name: Decimal Places
input-scroll-decimal-places.description: Number of digits shown after the dot when the decimal step is applied.

input-scroll-focus-only.name: Only When Focused
input-scroll-focus-only.description: Only change the value when the input is focused (cursor active). If off, hovering the input is enough.

input-scroll-wrap.name: Wrap Around Limits
input-scroll-wrap.description: When the value would overflow the input's max length, wrap around instead of clamping.

enable-debug-logs.name: Debug Logs
enable-debug-logs.description: Show detailed mod logs in Geode console.
